interpretation.primary_comparison: final_paired; earlier runs retained for transparency
interpretation.first_preview: Baseline often sleeps until the sampler exit deadline. This is not eight seconds of decoder processing. Final wakes on publication.
interpretation.desktop_rss: Not equivalent readiness: final uploads its preview before sampling, baseline generally after. Do not claim an RSS improvement or regression from this pair.
interpretation.ui_durations: Only one to four idle UI samples per launch. Not sufficient to claim responsiveness percentiles.
interpretation.first_ui: Final median 2.4 percent higher. No startup-speed improvement claimed.
interpretation.media: Decoder changes reverted. Final controls do not establish a seek-throughput or tail-latency improvement.
